_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Night Vision Imaging System (NVIS) Compatible Aircraft Interior Lighting Compliance Data
summary: Verifies compliance of NVIS-compatible aircraft interior lighting systems with the radiance, chromaticity, and photometric brightness requirements of MIL-L-85762A.
use_relationship:
This data verifies compliance with radiance, chromaticity and photometric brightness requirements of MIL-L-85762A, LIGHTING, AIRCRAFT, INTERIOR, NIGHT VISION IMAGING SYSTEM (NVIS) compatible.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
This DID supersedes DI-MISC-80113A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor format shall be used; however the sequence of data submitted shall closely correspond with the sequence of the requirements paragraphs of MIL-L-85762A.

children.title: Introductory information shall include the following:
Title, descriptive of each test to be conducted.
Identification of each lighting system, sub-system, or component being tested.
Type and class of NVIS compatible lighting system.

A graphics plot showing the spectral sensitivity of the spectroradiometer set at the control positions used during the lighting system, sub-system, or component measurements specified in 4.8.13 and 4.8.14 of MIL-L-85762A.

A graphics plot showing the spectral radiance of the lighting system, sub-system, or component on a semi-logarithmic scale over wavelengths from 380 nm to 930 nm as specified in 4.8.13 and 4.8.14 of MIL-L-85762A.
Tables.
children.content: A table showing the spectral radiance of the lighting system, sub-system, or component from 380 nm as specified in 4.8.13 and 4.8.14 of MIL-L-85762A.

children.title: All u' and v' 1976 UCS chromaticity coordinate calculations as specified in 4.8.13 of MIL-L-85762A.
All NVIS radiance calculations as specified in 4.8.14 of MIL-L-85762A.
Photometric brightness values as specified in 4.8.12 of MIL-L-85762A.
